law.title: Following too closely (2)
law.text: The driver of any truck or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, which is following a truck, or combination of vehicles 80 inches or more in overall width, shall, whenever conditions permit, leave a space of 500 feet so that an overtaking vehicle may enter and occupy such space without danger, but this shall not prevent a truck or combination of vehicles from overtaking and passing any vehicle or combination of vehicles. This subsection does not apply to any vehicle or combination of vehicles while moving on a highway on which there are two or more lanes available for traffic moving in the same direction.

activation_conditions: the subject is a truck or combination 80 inches or more in overall width
the vehicle ahead in the same lane is also a truck or combination 80 inches or more wide
the highway has fewer than two lanes for traffic in the subject's direction
exceptions: while overtaking and passing another vehicle or combination
on a highway with two or more lanes available for traffic moving in the same direction
'whenever conditions permit' — the space need not be left where traffic or the road makes it impossible
residue: 'whenever conditions permit' is a judgement element
overall width of a non-subject vehicle can only be estimated from kin.extent
summary.subject: truck_driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the 500-foot space is a standing requirement while following, not a single-instant test
a momentary closure during and immediately after an overtake is excepted; a bound on how long the gap may be short must be declared
